name: Sun River Gardens
description: A year-round garden reception venue at Sun River Gardens in Orem: The Garden Room is a climate-controlled greenhouse atrium with tropical and seasonal foliage, fountains, patios and a private bridal room.

Audio/Visual > TV.wording: 32” Flat Screen HD-TV and DVD player

Features > Indoors.wording: As a climate controlled atrium, The Garden Room

Decor > Centerpieces.wording: Ivy Topiaries and / or Lantern centerpieces for tables

Decor > Greenery / florals.wording: Tropical and seasonal foliage, flowering baskets

Other > Cake table.wording: Sign-in Table, Gift Table, Cake Table & T.V Table

items.label: Description
items.value: A year-round garden reception venue at Sun River Gardens in Orem: The Garden Room is a climate-controlled greenhouse atrium with tropical and seasonal foliage, fountains, patios and a private bridal room.

items.label: Packages & add-ons
items.value:
Tuesday-Thursday — $3,200
Friday & Saturday — $3,500
Includes wedding coordinator, 1-2 on-site coordinators, setup and teardown of tables, chairs and linens
Toppers, sashes, napkins, chair covers and extra runners — extra charge (prices not stated)

items.label: Indoors
items.value: As a climate controlled atrium, The Garden Room

items.label: The Garden Room (greenhouse atrium)
items.value: Size: 7,000+ sq ft · Setting: indoor, with doors to patios in warmer months

items.label: Included items
items.value:
12 60" round tables and 5 tallboy tables
Banquet tables on request
15 base table linens (70+ colors)
100+ cushioned chairs
Sign-in table, gift table, cake table and TV table
Ivy topiary and/or lantern centerpieces
4 floor easels (about 5 ft) and 2 tabletop easels
32" flat-screen HD TV and DVD player
Tropical and seasonal greenery, water features, gazebos and flowering baskets

items.label: Staff & coordination
items.value:
Wedding coordinator helps plan event details
1-2 wedding coordinators on-site during the event

items.label: Setup & cleanup
items.value: Staff set up and tear down tables, chairs and linens (general cleaning not stated)

items.label: TV
items.value: 32” Flat Screen HD-TV and DVD player

items.label: Equipment
items.value:
Yes
Overhead stereo system with iPod/iPhone connection
P.A. system with portable cordless microphone and stand

items.label: Centerpieces
items.value: Ivy Topiaries and / or Lantern centerpieces for tables

items.label: Greenery / florals
items.value: Tropical and seasonal foliage, flowering baskets

items.label: Signs / easels
items.value: (4) Easels approx. 5' tall, 2 tabletop easels also available

items.label: For rent
items.value: Table toppers, sashes, napkins, chair covers and additional runners (extra charge, prices not stated)

items.label: Extras
items.value:
Climate-controlled year-round (cooled to 75°F in warmer months)
Dancing area
Area for wedding gifts
Engagement/wedding photo sessions on the grounds — $50 site fee (by approval)

items.label: Staff
items.value: Wedding coordinator for planning; 1-2 coordinators on-site; Setup and teardown of tables, chairs, linens

items.label: Facility
items.value: Indoor and outdoor gardens; Private bridal room; 7,000+ sq ft; Caterer staging area (microwave, fridge, sink); Overhead stereo; P.A. with microphone; Gift area; Dancing area; Climate control

items.label: Furniture
items.value: 12 60-inch round tables; 5 tallboy tables; Banquet tables on request; 15 base linens (70+ colors); 100+ cushioned chairs; Sign-in, gift, cake and TV tables

items.label: Extras
items.value: 32-inch HD TV and DVD player; Ivy topiary and/or lantern centerpieces; 4 floor easels, 2 tabletop easels

items.label: Cake table
items.value: Sign-in Table, Gift Table, Cake Table & T.V Table

items.label: Kitchen / prep
items.value: Large caterer staging area with microwave, fridge and sink

items.label: Times
items.value:
Tuesday-Thursday
Friday-Saturday
No events in May

items.label: Restrictions
items.value: No events in May (busy garden retail season)

items.label: Notes
items.value:
Reception information is on sunriverreceptions.com, linked from the garden center's menu
Reception site notice (undated): venue is undergoing an expansion through mid-summer; inquiries and reservations accepted from late spring
Receptions offered since 2006

items.label: Contact
items.value:
Phone (receptions): 801-769-6805
Phone (garden center): 801-229-1975
Email: info@sunrivergardens.com
Instagram: @sunriverreceptions
